title: Sign In and Account Access
summary: The top navigation now uses a single Sign In entry, and account creation is available directly from the sign-in flow.
highlights: Single Sign In button in the main menu
Create account action inside the sign-in dialog
Password reset remains available in the same flow

title: Search Mode and Reading Mode
summary: We introduced two clear working modes so users can either explore broadly or read in sequence.
highlights: Prominent mode switch in the top navigation
Reading controls optimized for book/chapter navigation
Optional filter guidance in reading and browse views

title: Find Similar Hadith
summary: Each narration now shows similar hadith using semantic retrieval in Elasticsearch.
highlights: Inline similar hadith panel under each card
Upfront similar count shown on the trigger
Tabbed similar hadith browsing with full text display
